name: ThinkTwice
source:
A breathless, sensual and erotic game in six episodes in which three fates cross in the Caribbean

A not-so-nice London financier who wants his piece of the cake, a not-so-naive Danish Olympic medalist swimmer who gives back the blows she gets, and a not-so-honest young Cuban who doesn't want to die as poor as he was born.
How will life make them meet, love, tear apart, betray and hate each other? 
This is what this confusing visual novel full of twists and turns proposes to you to discover.

[From [url=https://ehelljay.itch.io/thinktwice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场令人窒息、感性和色情的游戏，共六集，三个命运在加勒比海交汇

一个不那么友善的伦敦金融家想要分得一杯羹，一个不那么天真的丹麦奥运会奖牌游泳运动员，她会反击她所受到的打击，还有一个不那么诚实的古巴年轻人，他不想像他出生时那样贫穷地死去。
生活将如何让他们相遇、相爱、分离、背叛、仇恨？
这就是这部充满曲折、令人困惑的视觉小说建议你去发现的内容。

[来自[url=https://ehelljay.itch.io/thinktwice]Itch.io[/url]]
